data.description: Innovative Design | Outstanding Amenities | Remarkable Property
data.display_address: Damac City, Al Safa 1, Al Safa, Dubai
data.long_description:
Safa One by Damac is a groundbreaking development in Dubai, crafted in collaboration with the famed jewelry designer Fawaz Gruosi, the creative force behind the De Grisogono brand. This iconic project comprises two towers, soaring 44 and 62 floors, and offers 1-3 bedroom apartments that exude luxury with designer finishes inspired by De Grisogono. The interiors are a masterpiece of vibrant colors and precious stones, setting new standards for elegance and making Safa One a striking addition to Dubai's skyline. Each residence features a private balcony, and select apartments include terraces with private pools.


  Safa One stands out for its innovative design, where every balcony is transformed into a mini garden, complete with a lush tree, infusing the building's modern architecture with a refreshing natural element. The sleek glass facades, harmonized with greenery, create an eco-friendly and visually stunning environment.


  Residents at Safa One enjoy a wealth of premium amenities. The development features two golden sand beach pools, a luxurious spa, a variety of cafes and restaurants, and scenic bicycle paths along the canal. The rooftop garden, 32 meters high, is the crown jewel, offering manicured landscapes and the soothing presence of soaring birds. The location is unbeatable, with Al Safa Park, one of Dubai's greenest spaces, and Dar Wasl shopping center within walking distance. Additionally, La Mer Beach is just a 15-minute drive away, while Dubai Mall and Dubai Marina are 10 and 25 minutes away, respectively.
